selection: Three focused native figures fill specific teaching gaps; the opening artwork and existing figures remain. No decorative images were added to every section.

changes.purpose: Make voltage, loop current, return path and resistor dissipation concrete using the existing 3.3 V / 10 kΩ example.
Show board and SoC boundaries, optional CPU/GPU/NPU roles and surrounding parts without claiming a particular product layout.
Distinguish 27 ms individual latency from 12 ms completion spacing using an explicitly hypothetical dedicated-resource pipeline.

evidence_review: Circuit quantities recomputed: 0.33 mA and 1.089 mW. Current arrows follow the complete conventional-current path; the ground mark is a reference.
Board map is explicitly conceptual; GPU/NPU presence and memory integration vary. It does not assert i.MX 93 contains a GPU.

MIT 6.004 definitions and bottleneck discussion inspected as S033. The original software schedule uses independently scheduled resources and is distinguished from the course’s clocked-register example.
All three frames have 27 ms latency; finishes at 27/39/51 ms are 12 ms apart. A focused test verifies each dedicated stage has no overlapping jobs.
No circuit experiment or hardware performance measurement performed.
refinements: Separated the two current-arrow paths so both source-to-load and return directions have visible arrowheads.
Hide panning hints at normal desktop widths when the SVG fits; keep them on narrow screens.
Complete visible text and Markdown equivalents retain quantities, roles, stage intervals and assumptions.
